page.overview:
What is Spikemuth?

Spikemuth is a town in the Galar region. It is home to Piers, the seventh Gym Leader of the Galar league, as well as his sister Marnie and her fanbase, Team Yell.

Unlike the other cities of Galar, Spikemuth's Gym is not built on top of a Power Spot, therefore making Pokémon incapable of using Dynamax and its variants. Chairman Rose tried to convince Piers to move elsewhere, but he opposed it. As such, Spikemuth is barely visited by most people, even though Piers is the second strongest Gym Leader in Galar.

A Team Yell Grunt at the shop west of the stage will offer to trade a Kantonian Mr. Mime nicknamed Mymo for an Obstagoon once.
